post.post_content:
Kinsta is premium managed WordPress hosting. It is fast, and Kinsta runs the server, the security and the support for you. It is also one of the most expensive hosts. The price does not jump at renewal, but you pay more for each site than on most budget hosts. This page puts the prices, the limits, the test results and the setup steps in one place. Prices and offers were read on Kinsta's own pages on 20 November 2026.

Is Kinsta worth it? The short version

  • Premium price, no renewal jump. The entry plan is $35 a month for one WordPress site and renews at $35.
  • Fast and steady in tests. EXPERTE measured a 0.23 s first response and the fewest slow responses of 14 hosts.
  • Support is chat only. Kinsta lists 24/7 human support in 8 languages and no phone line.
  • The first month is free until 1 December 2026 for new customers on select plans, and a 30-day money-back guarantee starts after the free period.
  • No email and no domain. You buy those elsewhere.

How much does Kinsta cost?

Kinsta sells managed WordPress plans. Single plans host one site. Larger plans host several. You can be billed by visits or by server bandwidth. The prices below are Kinsta's list prices, read on 20 November 2026 and checked against WPThinker (4 November 2026) and CuratorBits (verified 22 October 2026). Kinsta was testing two plan lists when WPThinker checked, so you may see different plan names.

PlanPrice a monthSitesVisits a monthStorage
Single 35k, or Single 20GB bandwidth$35135,00010 GB
Single 65k$50165,00010 GB
Single 125k$901125,00010 GB
Single 315k$1701315,00010 GB
WP 2$70270,00020 GB
WP 5$1155125,00030 GB
WP 10$22510315,00040 GB

Larger Single plans run to $290 and $375 a month, and custom Enterprise plans start above that. Annual billing saves about two months, according to WPThinker. WPThinker says the cheapest Single plan is not recommended for online stores or membership sites. Kinsta points stores to Single 65k or larger.

The price stays the same at renewal. After the offer, the entry plan renews at $35, as Kinsta's page states.

[[cta: See Kinsta plans | The first month is free for new customers until 1 December 2026. A 30-day money-back guarantee applies.]]

What is the Kinsta first month free and Black Friday offer worth?

On 20 November 2026, Kinsta's first-month-free page showed $0 for the first month on Single 20GB, Single 35k, Launch ($35 plans) and WP 2 ($70). After that, it showed 50% off for 3 months. The offer is for new customers and ends on 1 December 2026. We worked out the first year. This is our own arithmetic from Kinsta's prices.

Plan, billed monthlyFirst year at list priceFirst year with the offerYou save
$35 plan$420.00$332.50$87.50 (20.8%)
WP 2, $70$840.00$665.00$175.00 (20.8%)

The first month is free, the next 3 months are half price, and the other 8 months are at list price. The saving is real, but the list price matters more because you pay it for years.

Why is Kinsta so expensive?

Kinsta's price pays for management, support and included tools, not raw hardware. WPThinker compares the $35 Single plan (1 site, 10 GB) with a $14 Cloudways server (25 GB, room for many sites). EXPERTE ranked Kinsta's entry plan the second most expensive of the 14 hosts it compared. Overage fees add to the cost if a site grows. Kinsta lists $0.50 per 1,000 extra visits, $0.50 per extra GB of server bandwidth, $0.05 per extra GB of CDN bandwidth and $2 per extra GB of disk a month, according to WPThinker. Kinsta warns you at 80% and 100% of your limit.

Some add-ons cost more. WPThinker lists Redis at $100 a site a month, backups every 6 hours at $20 a site, and hourly backups at $100. CuratorBits lists Kinsta Automatic Updates at $3 per environment a month.

What do you get with Kinsta?

  • Fully managed hosting. You do not patch PHP or set up caching. You use the MyKinsta dashboard.
  • Cloudflare security and a large CDN. WPThinker says every plan has Cloudflare's enterprise-level security, and a CDN with more than 300 edge locations.
  • 30 data centers. You choose one for each site.
  • Daily backups, kept for 14 to 30 days, and a free staging site.
  • Free, unlimited migrations, done by Kinsta's engineers, and free malware removal.
  • SSH and WP-CLI on every plan, according to CuratorBits.

Kinsta lists a 99.9% uptime guarantee, with 99.99% as a paid upgrade. It does not include email hosting or a domain.

Is Kinsta good for WordPress?

Yes, for business sites, busy blogs and stores that want WordPress managed for them. It does one thing, managed WordPress, and the platform is built around it. If you want WordPress set up and kept running for you on any host, our website maintenance service covers updates, backups and speed checks. Kinsta also sells separate application and database hosting, according to WPThinker. Its managed plans are for WordPress only. If you need Drupal or Magento, check Kinsta's documents first.

How fast is Kinsta? What independent tests found

We did not run our own speed or uptime test. Independent teams did. They used different methods, so we list each.

TestSpeed resultUptime
EXPERTE, updated 10 August 2026. Same Elementor WordPress site on 14 hosts, six weeks0.232 s time to first byte (3rd of 14). 0.683 s Largest Contentful Paint (5th). 0.09% slow responses, the fewest of any host99.977%, about 14 minutes down in six weeks (9th of 14)
Webhostingcat, October 2026. GTmetrix and a Loader.io load test of 1,000 requests100% performance score, 77 ms time to first byte, 342 ms Largest Contentful Paint. Load test: 32 ms average, 100% successNot stated
WP Umbrella, June 2026. 20 Kinsta sites, 10 in Europe and 10 in the US, checks every minuteAbout 110 ms time to first byte in the US and 135 ms in Europe in an April 2026 spot check100% in the baseline run
Hostingstep, April 2026. Response-time test across hostsKinsta 469 ms, Cloudways 419 to 447 ms, WP Engine 367 ms, Hostinger 478 msNot stated

The pattern is clear. Kinsta is fast and very consistent, but it is not the fastest in every test. Hostingstep put it behind WP Engine and Cloudways on one response-time run. Edge caching can cut the first response by half or more when it is on, according to Webhostingcat. Google treats a Largest Contentful Paint of 2.5 seconds or less as good, and every result above is far under it.

[[cta: Want speed like this for your site? | Kinsta migrations are free, and a 30-day money-back guarantee starts after the free month.]]

How is Kinsta support?

  • Channels: 24/7 human support in 8 languages, by chat. There is no phone line.
  • Speed: WP Umbrella says replies were under 5 minutes in its ticket history. CuratorBits says Kinsta puts its average first response under 2 minutes.
  • What customers say: Support is the feature reviewers praise most. The gap is the phone: if you want to call someone, Kinsta is not for you.

Kinsta pros and cons

Pros

  • Fully managed WordPress with a clear dashboard.
  • Fast, consistent results in independent tests.
  • No renewal price jump.
  • Free, unlimited migrations and free malware removal.
  • Daily backups, staging, Cloudflare security and a large CDN on every plan.

Cons

  • A high price for one site and 10 GB of storage.
  • Overage fees and pricey add-ons such as Redis.
  • No email hosting, no domain and no phone support.
  • One site per Single plan.
  • Managed plans are for WordPress only.

Kinsta vs Cloudways: which is better?

KinstaCloudways
TypeFully managed WordPressManaged cloud servers
Entry price$35 a month, 1 site, 10 GB$11 to $14 a month, 25 GB, many sites
Renewal jumpNoneNone
Phone supportNoNo
Email and domainNot includedNot included
Best forBusiness sites that want everything managedGrowing sites that want server control

Kinsta costs more and manages more. Cloudways costs less and gives you more control. Read our Cloudways review for its plans and extras, and see all options in our best cloud hosting list and best web hosting services list.

Who should use Kinsta, and who should look elsewhere?

Kinsta suits: business sites, busy blogs, stores and agencies where downtime costs money and you want WordPress managed for you.

Look elsewhere if: you have a first or hobby site, your traffic is small, you want email bundled, or you want the lowest price. Our Hostinger review and Bluehost review cover cheaper options, and our DreamHost review covers many sites on one plan.

How do you build a WordPress site on Kinsta? Step by step

  1. Sign up and pick a plan. Choose Single 35k for a small site, or Single 65k or larger for a store. Use the first month free if you are a new customer.
  2. Choose a data center. Pick the one closest to your visitors. You choose one for each site.
  3. Move your site, or start a new one. Kinsta's engineers migrate an existing site for free. Or create a new WordPress install in MyKinsta.
  4. Connect your domain. Kinsta does not sell domains, so connect one you bought elsewhere.
  5. Test on staging. Use the free staging site to test updates before they go live.
  6. Check backups. Daily backups are on. Add more frequent backups only if you need them, because they cost extra.
  7. Watch your limits. Kinsta warns you at 80% and 100% of your visits. Set a reminder to review the plan.

Which Kinsta plan should you pick?

  • A personal blog or small business site: Single 35k.
  • A WooCommerce store or membership site: Single 65k or larger.
  • Two or more sites: WP 2 or WP 5.
  • An agency: Agency or Enterprise plans.

Final verdict: is Kinsta worth it in 2026?

Yes, if your WordPress site earns money or runs a business and you want it managed, fast and steady. It is not worth the price for a hobby site. Use the first month free before 1 December, and the 30-day guarantee after it, to test it.

Our interest in this topic

Reinforce Lab builds and maintains WordPress sites. We may earn a commission when you buy hosting through links on this page. We do not host our own site on Kinsta, so this is a research-based review. We read the host's pages and published tests, and we did not run our own. We do not sell hosting ourselves. How we researched this page is in the panel above.

rl_faqs:
What is Kinsta hosting? | Kinsta is premium managed WordPress hosting. It runs the server, security, backups and support, and you manage the site in its MyKinsta dashboard. Its managed plans are for WordPress.
Is Kinsta shared hosting? | No. Kinsta is managed WordPress hosting. WP Umbrella says every site runs in its own container, with no shared IP pools, which is different from shared hosting.
How much does Kinsta cost? | The entry plan is $35 a month for one WordPress site, 10 GB of storage and about 35,000 visits. WP 2 is $70 for two sites. Larger Single plans run from $50 to $375 a month. Annual billing saves about two months.
Does Kinsta cost more at renewal? | No. After the first month free and 3 months at half price, the entry plan renews at $35, the same list price. There is no first-term discount that expires.
Why is Kinsta so expensive? | The price pays for management, support and included tools, not raw hardware. WPThinker compares its $35 plan (1 site, 10 GB) with a $14 Cloudways server (25 GB, many sites). EXPERTE ranked its entry plan second most expensive of 14 hosts.
Does Kinsta have a free month or a money-back guarantee? | New customers get the first month free on select plans until 1 December 2026. Kinsta lists a 30-day money-back guarantee that starts after the free period.
Is Kinsta good for WooCommerce? | Yes on the right plan. WPThinker says Kinsta does not recommend the cheapest Single plan for stores and points to Single 65k at $50 or larger.
Is Kinsta fast? | Yes in independent tests. EXPERTE measured a 0.232 s time to first byte, 3rd of 14 hosts, and Webhostingcat measured 77 ms. Hostingstep found WP Engine and Cloudways slightly faster on one run.
Does Kinsta have phone support? | No. Kinsta lists 24/7 human support in 8 languages by chat. There is no phone line.
Does Kinsta include email or a domain? | No. Kinsta does not list email hosting or domain registration. You buy those elsewhere.
Does Kinsta host my FTP files? | Kinsta gives you SFTP and SSH access to your site files, according to reviewers, and it migrates your existing site for free. Check Kinsta's documents for the access details of your plan.
Does Kinsta support Drupal or Magento hosting? | Kinsta's managed hosting plans are for WordPress only, according to CuratorBits. WPThinker notes that Kinsta sells separate application and database hosting. Check Kinsta's documents for other platforms.
Is Kinsta better than Cloudways? | Kinsta costs more and manages more. Cloudways costs less and gives more server control. Both have no renewal jump and no phone support. Compare them at your own traffic.
